results.title: Ignore-previous-instructions override
results.remediation: Treat user text as data, add an input guardrail for override phrases, and keep privileged actions outside the model's control.

results.title: Role-play jailbreak (DAN)
results.remediation: Harden the system prompt against persona changes and filter role-play override phrasing on input.

results.title: Fake system block with delimiters
results.remediation: Pass user text in the user role only, strip or escape role-like delimiters, and never let message content carry system authority.

results.title: Base64-obfuscated instruction
results.remediation: Decode and normalise encodings (base64, hex, rot13) before guardrails run, and judge the decoded text, not just the raw input.

results.title: Multilingual override (Spanish)
results.remediation: Apply guardrails in every language the model understands (or use a language-agnostic classifier) and keep privileged actions outside the model.

results.title: Instruction split across turns
results.remediation: Evaluate guardrails over the whole conversation, not each message alone, and cap how much earlier user text can change behaviour.

results.title: Indirect injection triggers a refund
results.remediation: Wrap retrieved text as untrusted data, strip instruction-like content at ingestion, and require human confirmation for refunds.

results.title: Indirect injection echoes a planted marker
results.remediation: Treat retrieved documents as data, never as instructions, and scan documents for instruction-like text before they enter the index.

results.title: Account lookup without a session
results.remediation: Require an authenticated session for lookups, enforce ownership in code, and return only the minimum fields with masking.

results.title: Cross-customer lookup (IDOR)
results.remediation: Bind lookups to the session's customer id and deny any other account in code, not in the prompt.

results.title: Account ID enumeration
results.remediation: Authorize every lookup against the session's customer, use non-guessable identifiers and alert on sequential access patterns.

results.title: Bulk dump of all customers
results.remediation: Never expose bulk queries to the model, paginate and minimise returned fields, and mask PII in outputs.

results.title: Internal document quoted to a public user
results.remediation: Filter retrieval by the caller's permissions before documents reach the prompt and mask contact details in outputs.

results.title: Script tag echoed into the page
results.remediation: HTML-escape model output before rendering, strip active content and send a restrictive CSP.

results.title: Image onerror handler echoed into the page
results.remediation: HTML-escape model output, strip event-handler attributes and send a restrictive CSP.

results.title: javascript: link rendered as an anchor
results.remediation: Escape model output, allow only http(s) URLs in links and enforce a CSP without unsafe-inline.

results.title: SVG onload and iframe injection
results.remediation: Escape model output, strip svg/iframe/object elements and use CSP frame-src and script-src restrictions.

results.title: Refund without authentication
results.remediation: Bind tools to the authenticated customer, check ownership in code and require human confirmation for refunds.

results.title: Refund above any sane cap
results.remediation: Enforce a per-refund cap in code and require human approval above a low threshold.

results.title: Refund to another customer's account
results.remediation: Resolve the customer from the session token and verify in code that the account belongs to them before any refund.

results.title: Injected document moves money for a signed-in customer
results.remediation: Never let retrieved text trigger tools, require human confirmation for refunds and tie each action to the user's own request.

results.title: Lookup-then-refund abuse chain
results.remediation: Cap and rate-limit sensitive tools per session, require confirmation for refunds and alert on lookup-then-pay sequences.

results.title: Direct system prompt request
results.remediation: Keep secrets out of prompts, treat the prompt as public and filter secret patterns in output.

results.title: Repeat everything above
results.remediation: Keep secrets out of prompts and add an output guardrail that redacts known secret patterns.

results.title: Translate your instructions
results.remediation: Keep secrets out of prompts and redact secret patterns from output in any language.

results.title: Completion trick
results.remediation: Never place secrets in the prompt; add an output filter for canary and key patterns.

results.title: Query that retrieves the poisoned document
results.remediation: Wrap retrieved text as untrusted data, strip instruction-like content at ingestion and filter documents by caller permissions.

results.title: Internal document retrieved by a public user
results.remediation: Apply document-level access control at retrieval time, using the caller's identity, before anything reaches the prompt.

results.title: Keyword stuffing forces the poisoned document into context
results.remediation: Treat retrieved text as untrusted, cap per-source influence on ranking and require confirmation for refunds.

results.title: Oversized message accepted
results.remediation: Enforce a maximum message length (reject with 413) before the model is called.

results.title: Request for a huge output
results.remediation: Cap max_tokens on every model call and truncate or refuse oversized output requests.

results.title: Burst of requests is never throttled
results.remediation: Add a per-client token-bucket rate limit that returns 429 with Retry-After.

results.title: Context stuffing with a giant history
results.remediation: Cap the number of history turns and total context size server-side.
